name: Western Tiger Swallowtail
desc: Western Tiger Swallowtail (Papilio rutulus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Papilio rutulus, the western tiger swallowtail, is a swallowtail butterfly belonging to the Papilionidae family. The species was first described by Hippolyte Lucas in 1852.
